title: fix: inherit iframe sandbox flags in windows opened on the OpenURL navigation path

target.summary: The `initiator->GetParent()` check restricts sandbox enforcement to child frames, skipping top-level frames. Consequently, windows opened via `OpenURLFromTab` from a sandboxed top-level frame fail to inherit the opener's sandbox restrictions and can bypass popup blocking.
notes: faulty condition checking for parent frame, skipping top-level sandboxed frames
